name: Specimen
description: Geological specimen with full provenance, multi-angle photos, reasoning history, and family/memory integration.

image_url.description: Primary specimen photo (legacy; use SpecimenPhoto for full gallery)

photo_ids.description: SpecimenPhoto IDs with multi-angle capture data, quality scores

ai_confidence.description: Latest confidence. See IdentificationReasoning for full history.

rarity.description: Geological rarity (how rare this mineral is, globally)

collector_rarity_score.description: Personal collection rarity (1-5 stars for this collector)

geological_context_id.description: Link to GeologicalContext (mineral + region geological data)

verified.description: User or expert has verified the ID

verification_count.description: How many field tests or verification steps completed

reasoning_history_ids.description: IdentificationReasoning IDs for full reasoning audit trail

family_profile_id.description: Which family this specimen belongs to (for family collections)

memory_capsule_id.description: Which expedition MemoryCapsule it was found on

shared_collection_ids.description: SharedCollection IDs this specimen is featured in

weather.description: Weather snapshot at time/place of finding

lunar_phase.description: Lunar phase at time of finding

educational_value.description: Why this specimen teaches something valuable

badges_unlocked.description: Badge IDs earned by this specimen

synced.description: Has this been synced to cloud (for offline tracking)
